advisor_identified: John M. Sherwood, professor of history at Queen's University, working on French history and the history of technology; supervisor of Edward David Gregory's 1978 thesis.

doctorate.title: The life of Georges Mandel: a study in French politics from Clemenceau to Pétain

evidence.says: Identifies John M. Sherwood as a professor in the Department of History at Queen's for 22 years, states that he received his PhD from Columbia University, and names his 1970 book Georges Mandel and the Third Republic.

Columbia University Libraries catalogue attributes The life of Georges Mandel; a study in French politics from Clemenceau to Pétain to Sherwood, John M.; dates it 1967 [copyright 1970] and identifies it as a Columbia University thesis. The microfilm holding is also dated 1967.

The repository supplies Edward David Gregory's The Influence of French and English Socialism on the Early Thought of Friedrich Engels and Karl Marx, 1835-1847. Its title page identifies a Queen's University History PhD thesis, June 1978; acknowledgements (p. v, PDF p. 6) name Dr. John Sherwood as his supervisor.

notes: The advisor's institution, thesis author, year and title agree with linked AHA record 53297. The catalogue's 1970 copyright date is separate from its 1967 thesis date.
